About Pickrel Brothers

{COMPANY.name} is a wholesale distributor of pipe, valves, fittings, plumbing, heating and industrial supplies based at {COMPANY.address1} in Dayton, Ohio.

For more than 50 years we've supplied mechanical contractors, plumbers, HVAC professionals, maintenance departments, municipalities and industrial plants throughout the Dayton, Cincinnati and Springfield areas. Our customers keep coming back for the same reason: the people behind the counter know the products.

We stock what local contractors actually use, and we source what they can't find. Beyond distribution we thread, cut and roll groove pipe, actuate valves, lay out hydronic and steam systems, size water heaters and coils, and run storeroom programs for plants that can't afford downtime.

Ordering online should be quick. Getting the right part should be certain. That's why every page on this site puts a phone number next to the Add to Cart button — we're a distributor first, and an e-commerce site second.
